name: the-ranch-hand
description: The Ranch Hand — a two-sided marketplace connecting horse & farm-animal owners with experienced sitters.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run build -- --watch"
scripts.dev:vite: concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run seed
